changes.old: export function asOffNutriments(profile,unit){if(profile.kind!=='nutrientProfile'||profile.data.basis?.amount!==100||profile.data.basis.unit!==unit)throw Error(t("Nutrition basis must match this inventory item: per 100 {v0}.", {v0:(unit)}));const keys={energy:['energy-kcal_100g','kcal',1],protein:['proteins_100g','g',1],carbohydrate:['carbohydrates_100g','g',1],fat:['fat_100g','g',1],sugars:['sugars_100g','g',1],salt:['salt_100g','g',1],sodium:['sodium_100g','mg',.001],saturatedFat:['saturated-fat_100g','g',1],fibre:['fiber_100g','g',1],calcium:['calcium_100g','mg',.001],iron:['iron_100g','mg',.001],potassium:['potassium_100g','mg',.001],vitaminC:['vitamin-c_100g','mg',.001]};const result={};for(const [name,[key,unit,factor]]of Object.entries(keys)){const nutrient=profile.data.nutrients?.[name];if(typeof nutrient?.value==='number'&&Number.isFinite(nutrient.value)&&nutrient.value>=0&&nutrient.unit===unit)result[key]=nutrient.value*factor;}return result;}
